sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
The volume stated below is our fixed full demand for this part over the term, and we would place it all with you; the longer contract term also offers planning security as our forecast demand is rising. We appreciate the cost context you shared and understand that your management has frozen price cuts, as well as your focus on larger-volume customers. Given our long relationship, could the owner still walk us through the calculation as previously offered, and discuss whether other terms could be adjusted?

We confirm a binding volume of 20000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).
In our call of 2026-06-16 (doc:20260616-70620-M6) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Regarding your request to review the calculation, our pricing strictly reflects the previously shared cost indices and current operational realities. While we note your volume forecast and historical orders, they do not allow for further price adjustments under the current conditions. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms at a revised price of €4.94 per unit. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer is valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing the history and volume information and for moving your offer; we appreciate that, and understand your management’s position on price reductions and your need to focus on larger-volume customers. Our fixed full demand for this part, rising forecast and long contract term offer planning security, and our proposal moves toward you again. We appreciate our long relationship and your openness to walking us through your calculation; we understand that you cannot share more detail on material costs.

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.82 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We value our partnership and look forward to continuing to support your business with our extensive inventory and service.
